note: Autêntica monograph first published in 2003; ISBN confirmed in UESC’s catalogue report (2005 second edition, same print ISBN). The candidate História cultural: experiências de pesquisa is a different edited volume.

note: Brazilian selection of Perrot articles assembled by Maria Stella Martins Bresciani and translated by Denise Bottmann, first published in 1988. No matching selection is listed.
